set.body:
Reproduced by plsneuro MultirunFirstLevelProbe through public FmriDataset.open and FmriModelBuilder.buildPlanEither: two runs, each with trial-1 through trial-4, explicit run column and stimulus phase, fails before fit with DesignFailure(InvalidSchedule(phase stimulus parent trial ids must be unique)). Receipt /private/tmp/plsneuro-multirun-01.log, exit 1. Pinned ScalaFIM fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc; current native EventPhase.scala contains the same global uniqueness check.

Owner: ScalaFIM design/model. EventPhase.fromSchedule checks parentTrialIds.distinct globally although provenance already carries blockId. Investigate parent identity uses before changing the invariant. Preserve rejection of duplicate parent IDs within one phase/run, allow repeated labels in different runs with explicit scope, and ensure multiphase alignment includes run identity so repeated labels cannot hide misalignment. Do not rename user trial labels in the application.

Acceptance: shared JVM+JS regression tests cover cross-run reuse, within-run duplicates and mismatched phase run assignment; downstream disk-backed condition, condition-FIR and trial-FIR runwise fits recover distinct run effects and retain disjoint run-local coefficient identities. Audit any parent-keyed joins to prevent cross-run merging. Consumer integration tracked in plsneuro E0.6 bd-01M1SATXKC317SRQ1BN3TPRYGG (foreign-store reference only).
set.title: Scope phase parent-trial uniqueness to runs
